title: Files
summary: Find, inspect, enrich, and safely transform durable uploads, including bounded music metadata batches.

create.reason: Durable files enter through user uploads or specialized artifact-producing workflows; no generic model-authored file creation operation is exposed.

batch.reason: One exact file metadata read preserves one checksum and provenance identity; collection discovery uses file_search.

update.note: The compatibility singleton input remains accepted; new multi-file enrichment uses the bounded atomic updates array.

delete.reason: Stored file bytes and provenance are immutable evidence; no destructive file deletion operation is exposed to the agent.

resources.title: Activity file attachment
resources.summary: An ordered role-qualified file attached to an immutable activity event.
resources.reason: The activity ledger owns immutable request and result provenance attachments.

resources.title: Correspondence file attachment
resources.summary: A provider-ingested attachment retained with one correspondence record.
resources.reason: Correspondence synchronization owns attachment identity and lifecycle.
